title: ceanothus velutinus subsp. hookeri
intro: Ceanothus velutinus subsp. hookeri, commonly known as Rocky Mountain whitebark ceanothus, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Rhamnaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Ceanothus velutinus subsp. hookeri include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its traditional use in treating coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
